answer.justification: Every level matches quantization. The mid-layer size ratio is 0.968, a shrinking internal state that the document says only quantization shows. Effective rank is 4.09, direction consistency 0.514 and final cosine 0.966, the noise-like pattern of quantization. The relative-L2 curve (0.096 / 0.184 / 0.194 / 0.205 / 0.255) rises early and then stays flat, with onset at layer 11 and a final-layer jump of only +0.027. The logit change is the smallest of any class (KL 0.039, top-1 agreement 0.957, raw-score shift 2.8). The fine-tunes are ruled out by their size ratio above 1, and fine-tune bias also by its much larger raw-score shift (about 10) and higher consistency (0.70). The system-prompt classes are ruled out because this model diverges late (median position 8.5) and has no layer-2 spike (0.1 vs about 42). Its text shows no stage directions, cuisine mentions or marker prefix. Refusal changes are small (1 added, 3 dropped), and disclaimers are unchanged, which fits quantization.
